sup:chain: Chains 2 additional times, each time to another enemy (never the same one twice): strong in packs, adds nothing against a lone boss. Each jump hits 8% harder than the last, so a full chain hits the last enemies hardest. 5% less damage. A projectile that still pierces flies on first and chains once its pierce runs out (a Ballista bolt chains at its first enemy). A Spark's leaps are not projectiles: they gain the extra leaps, but each leap still loses a tenth of its damage.
sup:multiple_projectiles: Fires 2 additional projectiles in a fan. 15% less damage. Each enemy is hit by one projectile per cast; the extras hit the pack behind.
sup:concentrated: 30% less area of effect. 35% more damage.
sup:added_lightning: Adds 1 to 6 lightning damage, scaled up by the skill's gem level like its own damage, and +10% chance to Shock.
sup:added_poison: Adds 1 to 6 poison damage, scaled up by the skill's gem level like its own damage. The skill's poison damage penetrates 10% poison resistance. Supports Attack and Spell skills: any hit with poison damage can poison. Supported skills' poisons, bleeds and ignites deal 40% less damage. On a minion skill its minions' hits carry it at half strength.
sup:added_fire: Spells gain 2 to 5 fire damage, scaled up by the skill's gem level like its own damage (not a summon's minions). Every skill gains 30% of its physical damage as extra fire damage: it counts the physical left after conversion, so it adds less with Lightning, Flame, Ice or Venom linked.
sup:elemental_focus: 30% more elemental damage. Damage converted to Fire, Cold or Lightning (Flame, Ice, Lightning) counts as elemental too.
sup:toxic_focus: 25% more poison damage: poison hits and the poisons they apply. Damage converted to Poison (Venom) counts as poison too.
sup:faster_casting: 25% more cast speed. On a summon of casters (Skeletal Mage): they cast 25% faster.
sup:faster_attacks: 25% more attack speed. On a summon: its minions attack 25% faster.
sup:penetration: Hits ignore 20% of enemy elemental resistance.
sup:life_leech: 1.5% of the damage the skill deals is leeched as life, and it deals 15% more damage while you are leeching (below full life).
sup:brutality: 50% more physical damage, and attacks get another 7.4% more on top (about 61% in all). Minions get the 50%. Deals no elemental damage. Linked with Lightning, Flame or Ice, the converted share is lost. Heralds of Embers, Rime and Storms add nothing to it (their extra damage is elemental); Herald of Rot still does.
sup:pierce: Projectiles pierce 2 additional targets. 10% less damage.
sup:spell_echo: The spell repeats once. 15% less damage. 10% less cast speed. On a channel it adds an echo pulse every 2nd tick at 90% of the hit. An echoed curse is 20% stronger and an echoed war cry's Resolve lasts 1 second longer. Never repeats a dash, a Vow, a toggle like Orbiting Hammers or a spell a trigger casts, and a triggered cast pays none of its price (a Spark still gains its extra spark body). Repeats from a support gem and from your gear or passive tree stack, but the repeats from the smaller of the two deal 50% less damage.
sup:melee_physical: 40% more melee physical damage. 10% less attack speed. Works on melee minions. It scales only the physical left after conversion.
sup:controlled_destruction: 40% more spell damage. -40% to Critical Strike Multiplier. 10% less cast speed.
sup:bloodbound: The linked skill costs life instead of mana (20% more cost) and deals 10% more damage, another 10% more while you are below half your life. The classic way to keep a channel running on an empty mana pool: pair it with Siphon or Vow of Vigor.
sup:siphon: 2% of the linked skill's damage is leeched as life; attacks also leech 1% as mana. A totem's hits leech at 30% of that.
sup:tithe: Every hit of the linked skill returns 2 mana plus 0.4% of your maximum mana (attacks) and every kill 6 mana plus 2% of your maximum mana (spells, attacks and the kills of a linked summon's minions). On a Guardian or Unique enemy, every 4% of its life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) the linked skill takes returns its kill mana.
sup:woebringer: The linked Woe becomes an aura around you: while sworn it reserves 30% of your mana and lays the Woe on every enemy within 4.5 metres, more with area size on the Woe (Dread grows while they stay in it). Press the skill again to end it.
sup:pass_sentence: When the Sentenced enemy dies, the Sentence passes to the nearest rare or unique enemy (else the nearest enemy) within 10 metres.
sup:gather_fury: Kills with the linked skill grant a Fury charge (at most one every half second). Fury: 4% more damage and 4% increased attack and cast speed per charge. On a minion skill half of its minions' kills grant you the charge. On a Guardian or Unique enemy, every 4% of its life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) the linked skill takes counts as a kill.
sup:bloodlust_support: Each kill with the linked skill grants 1 stack of Bloodlust: 0.6% more damage for each stack, up to 50 stacks. Each stack lasts 5 seconds, so keep killing to keep it up. On a minion skill half of its minions' kills grant you the stack.
sup:war_banner_support: Retired: the War Banner is now a skill gem of its own. Any War Banner support you had became the War Banner skill gem.
sup:hunters_mark_support: Each hit with the linked skill puts 1 Hunter's Mark on the enemy: it takes 1.4% more damage for each Mark, up to 10, twice as many on a Guardian or a Unique. The Marks fall off 3 seconds after your last hit, so keep shooting. Marks and your War Banner do not add up: an enemy takes the stronger of the two. On a minion skill it works at half strength.
sup:woe_bearer: The linked Woe is borne by your blows: every enemy your hits strike takes it too, while it has room for another Woe (it never replaces one). The Woe can still be cast. Two Woe Bearers work at once.
sup:totem_support: The spell is no longer cast by you: casting places a totem where you aim (up to 9 metres away; 1 at a time, 8 seconds) that casts it at the nearest enemy every 0.8 seconds. Only Projectile, Chain, Nova and Skyfall spells can become a totem (not Winter Orb, Orbiting Hammers or any Spark). Spell Echo and other spell repeats also echo the totem's casts, each echo dealing 20% less damage (a totem's pace ignores cast speed). The skill's other supports apply to the totem's casts. 35% less damage. For bow skills, use Arrow Totem.
sup:arrow_totem: The bow skill is no longer fired by you: firing places a totem where you aim (up to 9 metres away; 1 at a time, 8 seconds) that fires it at the nearest enemy every 0.8 seconds. Only bow skills that shoot arrows can become a totem (not Rain of Arrows, Wind Vault or the Ballista). The skill's other supports apply to the totem's shots, and Multiple Totems adds more totems. 35% less damage.
sup:multiple_totems: You may have 1 additional totem or ballista of the supported skill at once, and it recovers 20% faster. Gem levels never add totems; the passive tree and items can add more. 20% less damage. All your skills together stand at most 6 Ballistas and 10 Totems. Totems and Ballistas of one skill share their damage: each past the first adds 80% of one's damage, and each past the sixth adds 20%.
sup:bone_guard: Minions from the supported skill stay close and take on what comes at you. They have 20% more life, 50% more armour and regenerate 2.5% of their life per second. While one stands within 9 metres, you have 30% more armour plus 10 armour per level, and regenerate 1% of your life per second.
sup:ravening_host: Minions from the supported skill range ahead of you and hunt, engaging enemies 50% farther away. They deal 25% more damage and move, attack and cast 15% faster.
sup:zap_support: Turns the skill to lightning: 60% of Physical, Fire and Cold damage is converted to Lightning (Poison at half: 30%). Hits shock with 30% increased effect of Shock, and its Shocks stack: 1 more Shock can sit on an enemy. A spinning attack calls lightning down from the sky onto the enemies it cuts. (Not the Zap spell: Zap is a skill gem of its own.) Physical bonuses (Added Fire, Melee Physical, Brutality) only see the 40% left physical.
sup:flame_support: 60% of Physical, Cold and Lightning damage is converted to Fire (Poison at half: 30%). Hits ignite. Physical bonuses (Added Fire, Melee Physical, Brutality) only see the 40% left physical.
sup:ice_support: 60% of Physical, Fire and Lightning damage is converted to Cold (Poison at half: 30%). Hits chill; chilled kills shatter. Physical bonuses (Added Fire, Melee Physical, Brutality) only see the 40% left physical.
sup:venom_support: 60% of Physical, Fire, Cold and Lightning damage is converted to Poison. +25% chance to Poison. Poison hits ignore 15% of Poison resistance. Physical bonuses (Added Fire, Melee Physical, Brutality) only see the 40% left physical.
sup:skyfall: The skill strikes from the sky at its target instead of travelling (every chain target is struck from above; a bow's arrows drop point-first). A Nova falls on its target up to 9 metres away and blooms there. On Earthshatter a meteor of the slam's element falls at the end of the fissure. Only Projectile, Chain, Brand and Nova spells (every Spark), projectile attacks (not Crescent Slash's wave) and the Ballista's volley can fall; each enemy is struck once per use. Spells deal 20% more damage. A skill takes one shape: with Orbit, Rain, Trap or Totem also socketed, the first one socketed is used (a Totem or Trap always places it) and Skyfall adds only its damage. Winter Orb and Orbiting Hammers keep circling.
sup:tether: Each enemy hit is linked to up to 2 other enemies within 5 metres for 3 seconds; linked enemies take 15% of the hit's damage per second.
sup:swift_step: The movement skill has a 40% shorter cooldown and deals 20% more damage.
sup:channel_conduit: While you channel, your linked spell casts itself at the nearest enemy every 0.5 seconds for half its mana cost, with this skill's other supports. Drop a spell on it to link it; unlinked, it casts nothing. 30% more channelling cost. Works with Cyclone and every channelled attack. Triggered spells must be on your skill bar, are never placed as totems or traps, and never trigger anything themselves.
sup:honed_edge: +1% to base Critical Strike Chance and 80% increased Critical Strike Chance. Best on a build that already raises its critical strikes. On a minion skill it works at half strength.
sup:deathblow: +50% to Critical Strike Multiplier: critical strikes hit much harder. Best with Honed Edge or other critical strike chance. On a minion skill it works at half strength.
sup:orbit: The skill's projectiles first circle you for 1.5 seconds, then each flies at the nearest enemy (a bow's arrows circle nose-first). Spells gain +1 projectile. Not on a skill that already circles you, such as Orbiting Hammers or Winter Orb (each keeps its own ring), and not on Crescent Slash's wave. Every projectile circles, up to 24 at once. Every projectile strikes; one sent at an enemy this cast already struck deals 75% less damage (an arrow or thrown blade 90% less: spread them over a pack). A skill takes one shape: Orbit keeps it circling even with Meteor Lore (the fall gives way), and with another shape gem socketed the first one socketed is used.
sup:channel_mastery: Up to 25% more damage, ramping in over the first second of channelling. 20% less channelling cost.
sup:minion_damage: Minions from the supported skill deal 40% more damage.
sup:minion_life: Minions from the supported skill have 60% more life.
sup:minion_speed: Minions from the supported skill move, attack and cast 25% faster.
sup:fork: Projectiles fork into two on hitting an enemy: each flies on to either side for 70% of the hit. A projectile that still pierces forks once its pierce runs out; Shuriken Fan and melee waves fork at their first enemy and fly on, and a Ballista bolt forks at its first enemy.
sup:rain_support: The projectiles no longer fly: they go up and rain down on the target area, striking every enemy inside three times (four times with 4 or more projectiles). 30% less damage. A Ballista's bolts rain down on its target twice. Not on Winter Orb, Orbiting Hammers or Crescent Slash's wave: they cannot rain.
sup:trap_support: The skill is thrown as a trap (up to 3, 16 seconds). Not on Winter Orb, Orbiting Hammers, Crescent Slash or the Storm, Rime and Venom Sparks: they cannot be thrown. It is live the moment it lands and goes off the instant an enemy comes within 4 metres; its first strike deals 30% more damage, then it re-arms about a second later (sooner with faster re-arm). It also fits a bow Ballista. A Trap that goes off sets off your other Traps nearby. 35% more damage. Your Traps out at once share their damage: each Trap past the first adds 90% of a Trap's damage, and each past your sixth (all your Trap skills count) adds 40%; an Attack a Trap throws counts its Effectiveness past 800% at 25% (Wheeling Axe, Shield Throw and Glacial Shards hit that hard by hand).
sup:afterimage: Supported melee attacks are repeated once by a ghost of the swing. 20% less damage. On a skill with several blows (Flurry, Soul Rend, Thunderfall, Twin Cuts and Viper Fang) every blow is repeated, and every cut of Thousand Cuts. Repeats from a support gem and from your gear or passive tree stack, but the repeats from the smaller of the two deal 50% less damage.
sup:affliction_support: +35% chance to Ignite and +35% chance to Poison. 50% increased Burning and Poison damage. 10% less damage with hits.
sup:stormfrost_support: +25% chance to Shock and 50% increased effect of Shock. Cold hits build up Freeze 60% faster, and its Lightning damage is 15% more against Chilled or Frozen enemies.
sup:repeat_support: Bow skills fire 1 more time, a moment later (a Ballista fires each bolt twice). Channelled skills strike 1 more time inside each pulse. 40% less damage. Repeats from a support gem and from your gear or passive tree stack, but the repeats from the smaller of the two deal 50% less damage.
sup:cast_on_crit: When one of your attacks lands a critical hit, the spell this is socketed in casts itself at the enemy struck, for 50% of its mana cost. Spells that cast themselves this way take turns: at most one of them every 0.3 seconds. The triggered spell deals 25% less damage. In an attack or a spell, its crits cast the spell dropped on its link. On top of that, every Cast on Crit you have shares one clock: at most one cast every 0.15 seconds, taking turns, so one critical hit casts one spell; with nothing linked, the attack strikes by itself when your other attacks crit, at most once every 0.75 seconds for all such attacks, for a further 44% less damage (a Rain drops one wave, and Repeat, Afterimage or Multistrike never repeat it). Movement skills, Blade Vortex, Sheathe, channels, auras and Heralds never cast or strike by themselves: link a spell to them. One link per skill. Triggered spells must be on your skill bar, are never placed as totems or traps, and never trigger anything themselves. Fits totems and ballistas too: a totem's trigger fires at most once per second. A totem's or ballista's crit casts only the spell on its own link, never your other Cast on Crit spells.
sup:cast_when_hit: Each time you have taken damage equal to 10% of your maximum life, the spell this is socketed in casts itself at the attacker, at most once every 0.5 seconds, for 50% of its mana cost. The triggered spell deals 10% less damage. In an attack, or to cast another spell, drop a spell on its link. One link per skill. Triggered spells must be on your skill bar, are never placed as totems or traps, and never trigger anything themselves. Fits totems and ballistas too: a totem's trigger fires at most once per second.
sup:cast_on_minion_death: When a minion from this skill dies, your linked spell casts itself at the enemy nearest to where it fell, at most once per second, for 50% of its mana cost and with this skill's other supports. The linked spell deals 10% less damage. Drop a spell on it to link it; unlinked, it casts nothing. One link per skill: the first linking support socketed works. Triggered spells must be on your skill bar, are never placed as totems or traps, and never trigger anything themselves.
sup:rend: Physical hits of this skill have a 50% chance to cause Bleeding: 50% of the hit's physical damage each second for 4 seconds (the strongest bleed holds; 50% more while the enemy moves). 60% more Bleeding damage. On a minion skill it works at half strength.
sup:deep_wounds: +40% to Damage over Time Multiplier for this skill: its Ignites, Poisons and Bleeding deal 40% more damage. Hits are unchanged. On a minion skill it works at half strength.
sup:living_storm: This skill's Shocks stack: 2 more Shocks can sit on an enemy (3 in all), adding up to at most 75% more damage taken. +25% chance to Shock with Lightning hits. On a minion skill it works at half strength.
sup:contagion_flame: When an enemy this skill ignited dies, its Ignite spreads (100% chance) to enemies within 4.5 metres. While it burns, every second it also passes its Ignite to the nearest enemy within 3 metres that burns less. +15% chance to Ignite with Fire hits. On a minion skill it works at half strength.
sup:shatter: Chilled or Frozen enemies this skill kills shatter: 12% of their maximum Life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) as Cold damage to enemies within 3.5 metres, chilling them, and an enemy the burst kills shatters in turn. 20% increased effect of Chill. On a minion skill it works at half strength.
sup:melee_splash: Every blow splashes: enemies within 2 metres of each enemy struck take 55% of the blow's damage (once per blow). 10% less damage. Works on minions: their blows splash too.
sup:multistrike: The melee attack strikes 3 times: it repeats 2 more times and every strike deals 48% of the damage (52% less). On a skill with several blows (Flurry, Soul Rend, Thunderfall, Twin Cuts and Viper Fang) every blow is repeated, and every cut of Thousand Cuts. Works on minions: each of their blows strikes 2 more times. Repeats from a support gem and from your gear or passive tree stack, but the repeats from the smaller of the two deal 50% less damage.
sup:maim: Hits Maim the enemy for 4 seconds: it moves 30% slower and takes 20% more Physical damage from you, your minions and your allies. 8% more Physical damage. Works on minions. Only the Physical part counts: damage converted to an element (Lightning, Flame, Ice or Venom linked) gains nothing from Maim.
sup:ruthless: Every third blow is a Ruthless blow: 60% more Physical damage and a heavy, bloody impact. Works on minions: every third blow of each minion.
sup:executioner: 35% more damage against enemies below half their life, and hits kill enemies left below 10% of their life (Guardians too). Works with bows and on minions.
sup:vicious_projectiles: 40% more Physical damage with projectiles, 10% less attack speed. Only the Physical part counts: it adds nothing to damage converted to an element (Lightning, Flame, Ice or Venom linked). On a summon it fits minions that shoot, at half strength.
sup:added_cold: Adds 3 to 4 cold damage to spells and attacks, scaled up by the skill's gem level like its own damage. Steadier than Added Lightning (1 to 6) for the same average: it chills where Added Lightning shocks.
sup:chain_detonation: Supports skills thrown as Traps. A Trap that goes off sets off your other Traps nearby, one after another. Traps set each other off at 100% increased distance, and each Trap further down the chain deals 8% more damage. +1 to the maximum number of Traps.
sup:volatile_dead: Minions from the supported skill explode where they fall: when killed, when their time runs out, or when a new cast replaces them past your limit. Each blast deals Fire Damage in 3 metres equal to 20% of the minion's maximum Life plus 50% of its hit damage. Recast at your limit to detonate your oldest minions.
sup:funeral_pyre: Enemies killed by the supported skill's hits burst into flame where they fall, dealing Fire Damage in 2.5 metres equal to 15% of their maximum Life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life). The burst is not the skill's hit, so what it kills does not burst again.
sup:inspiration: The linked skill costs 25% less. No damage of its own: it keeps a spammed spell or attack firing.
sup:economical_vow: The linked Vow or Herald reserves 20% less of your pool (a Herald 25% to 20%). Room for one more Vow or a bigger mana pool for your spells.
sup:wide_burst: The linked Herald's kill effect reaches 60% further: Embers and Rot burst over 4 metres, Rime shatters over 4.8 metres, Storms arcs to enemies within 8 metres. The extra damage share on your hits is unchanged.
sup:ruinous_herald: The linked Herald's kill effect deals 60% more damage (Embers 12% of the slain enemy's maximum life becomes 19.2%). Kills that chain into kills: a clear speed pick. The extra damage share on your hits is unchanged.
sup:lingering_woe: The linked Woe builds Dread 50% faster and lasts 50% longer on every enemy it touches (cast, channelled, borne by Woe Bearer or sworn with Woebringer).
sup:dawnbringer: Every third hit of the linked Holy attack calls a pillar of dawn on the enemy, dealing 50% of the hit as Fire Damage (at most once a second on the same enemy). For Holy Slash, Hallowed Slam, Holy Charge and Shield Throw; it stacks with the Dawnward Bulwark and Radiant Crusade, each counts its own hits.
sup:grave_conscription: Enemies killed by the linked attack have a 25% chance to rise as one of your Zombies while you have fewer than 4 (at most once every half second). Your minion damage and life apply to them, and if you also have Raise Zombie, its minion supports do too. Any attack build can grow a small horde.
sup:venom_bloom: Every fourth hit of the linked Poison attack bursts in venom: enemies within 2.5 metres take 45% of the hit as Poison Damage (at most once every 0.2 seconds, each enemy at most once every 0.5 seconds). For Gravereap, Soul Rend and Marrow Lance: a pack clear for poison melee.
sup:sanctified_support: Turns the linked Holy attack to holy light: 60% of its Fire, Cold and Lightning damage is converted to Physical (Poison at half: 30%), so added elemental damage from your gear feeds your Physical bonuses, and it deals 15% more Physical Damage. The Paladin's answer to Zap, Flame, Ice and Venom; pairs with Brutality.
sup:whirling_host: The linked Orbit skill adds one more blade or hammer with each cast and its ring holds one more (Blade Vortex 9 instead of 8, Orbiting Hammers 4 instead of 3), each dealing 15% less damage. A wider, fuller ring that fills faster and catches more of the pack.
sup:conjured_pair: The linked Orb skill keeps one more orb at a time (Winter Orb: two orbs by your shoulders, both formed by one cast), each dealing 35% less damage. Twice the icicles over twice the ground: more coverage, a little more damage in all.
sup:rampart_strike: The linked Shield attack deals 0.8% more damage for every 1% chance to block you have (at 50% block: 40% more, at 75%: 60% more). Shield Charge, Holy Charge and Shield Throw: the block you build to live now hits back.
sup:deepened_woe: Every line of the linked Woe is 25% stronger: the damage it makes enemies take, the resistance it lowers, the damage they deal less and its slow. The Woe's own build, for when one Woe carries the whole party.
sup:tempered_aura: The linked damaging aura gnaws 40% less of your life (Unholy Void 0.9% to 0.54% a second, Pyre of Faith 6% to 3.6%). Stand in the fire longer: the support for life stacking aura builds.
sup:spreading_pyre: The linked corpse skill's fire leaps on to 2 more fresh corpses, one after another, each within the burst's radius of the last. Each leap bursts for its own corpse's life and deals 60% of the leap before it (Pyre Burst at gem 20: 10% of the slain's life, then 6%, then 3.6%). Corpses its own fire makes can carry it on: a pack goes up like kindling.
sup:defiant_roar: The linked war cry also grants a Fury charge for each Resolve charge it grants (Jarl's Roar into 3 enemies: 3 Resolve and 3 Fury), and that Resolve lasts 50% longer (10 s to 15 s). Fury: 4% more damage and 4% increased attack and cast speed each. The roar that holds the line now pays you to stand in it.
sup:rallying_standard: The linked War Banner lands with 5 Valour already raised, keeps all of its Valour when you move it (not half), and holds up to 10 more (20 to 30). Each Valour is 0.5% more damage taken by enemies near it: a banner you can carry from pack to pack and plant straight into a Guardian fight.
sup:focused_volley: The linked bow skill fires 1 more arrow, and all its arrows fly on one line at your target, each with its own hit, so one enemy can take every arrow. Each arrow after the first deals 60% of the one before it (2 arrows: 100% + 60%; 4 arrows: 100% + 60% + 36% + 22%), and the skill deals 15% less damage. A Guardian killer: you give up the spread. Arrows you shoot yourself only (not a trap, totem or rain).
sup:killer_instinct: Your linked minions strike for the throat: +4% to their base critical strike chance, 100% increased critical strike chance and +40% to critical strike multiplier. The crit support minion builds never had: your tree's minion and critical strike lines now have something to scale.
sup:ironclad_fury: The linked skill deals 2% more damage per 1,000 Armour, 1.5% more per 1,000 Evasion, 3.5% more per 1,000 maximum Energy Shield and 2.5% more per 1,000 maximum Life you have. Past 12,000 Armour or Evasion, 6,000 Energy Shield or 5,000 Life each 1,000 counts a quarter. At 16,000 Armour and 8,000 Life: 40% more. It adds into the same damage engine as the passive tree's lines that pay your defences. Any attack or spell, totems and traps too: the walls you built now hit back.
